explanation: Miyamoto joined Nintendo as an artist in 1977. He has said that exploring caves and woods near Kyoto as a boy inspired The Legend of Zelda.

claims.text: Shigeru Miyamoto created Donkey Kong, Super Mario Bros. and The Legend of Zelda for Nintendo.
Hideo Kojima, Satoshi Tajiri and Toru Iwatani did not create Donkey Kong, Super Mario Bros. or The Legend of Zelda.
Shigeru Miyamoto joined Nintendo as an artist in 1977.
Miyamoto has said that his childhood explorations of the countryside near Kyoto, including a cave, inspired The Legend of Zelda.
